---
title: "Visium preprocessing trajectories"
author: "Asier Antoranz"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---

Filters, normalises, integrates and imputes Visium expression, scores melanoma metaprogrammes and projects melanoma-enriched spots onto the Xenium trajectories.

**Inputs:** Visium count matrices and spatial images in `paper_data/Visium/raw`; cell2location weights, signatures and projection settings in `paper_data/Visium/inputs`; Xenium models and annotations from notebooks 02 and 04.

**Outputs:** The final `data/visium_analysis.rds` contains section objects, integration reductions, MAGIC expression, metaprogramme scores/memberships and trajectories. SCT and MAGIC checkpoints are retained for the costly steps; summary tables are exported to `results/` and `data/`, with spatial, composition and projection panels in `figures/`.

```{r spot_identity_and_projection_helpers}

patient_from_spot <- function(spot) {
  sample <- sub('_[^_]+$', '', spot)
  patient <- samples$patient[match(sample, samples$sample)]
  if (anyNA(patient)) stop('Unknown Visium sample: ', paste(unique(sample[is.na(patient)]), collapse = ', '))
  patient
}

nearest_on_skeleton <- function(points, skeleton) {
    start <- skeleton[-nrow(skeleton), , drop = FALSE]
    delta <- skeleton[-1, , drop = FALSE] - start
    length2 <- rowSums(delta^2)
    distance <- rep(Inf, nrow(points))
    projected <- matrix(0, nrow(points), 2)
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(start))) {
        fraction <- rowSums(sweep(points, 2, start[j, ], "-") * matrix(delta[j, ], nrow(points), 2, byrow = TRUE))/length2[j]
        fraction <- pmin(pmax(fraction, 0), 1)
        candidate <- sweep(outer(fraction, delta[j, ]), 2, start[j, ], "+")
        current <- sqrt(rowSums((points - candidate)^2))
        update <- current < distance
        distance[update] <- current[update]
        projected[update, ] <- candidate[update, ]
    }
    data.frame(pt1_line = projected[, 1], pt2_line = projected[, 2])
}

```

```{r composition_plot_function}

patient_colors <- setNames(c('#D55E00', '#E69F00', '#009E73', '#56B4E9', '#0072B2', '#CC79A7'), c('thinmme008', 'thinmme004', 'thinmme003', 'thinmme006', 'thinmme005', 'thinmme007'))

comparison_plot <- function(data, x, y, facet) {
    ggplot(data, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]])) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") + 
        geom_point(aes(color = patient), size = 2) + ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "spearman", r.accuracy = 0.01, p.accuracy = 0.001, 
        size = 2.3, label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top") + facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", facet)), scales = "free", 
        nrow = 1) + scale_color_manual(values = patient_colors) + labs(x = "Xenium fraction", y = "Visium fraction", 
        color = NULL) + theme_bw(base_size = 8) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(size = 7))
}

```

## Visium inputs and patient identities

```{r import_spot_metadata}

spots <- lapply(samples$sample, function(sid) {
    counts <- Read10X_h5(file.path(raw_dir, sid, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"))
    data.frame(spot = paste(sid, colnames(counts), sep = "_"), sample = sid, nCount = Matrix::colSums(counts), 
        nFeature = Matrix::colSums(counts > 0))
})
spots <- bind_rows(spots)
spots$patient <- patient_from_spot(spots$spot)
spots$QC_750_keep <- spots$nFeature >= 750

```

```{r align_lineage_weights}

weights <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, 'lineage_weights.rds'))
melanoma <- weights$spot[weights$melanoma_analysis]
spots$melanoma_analysis <- spots$spot %in% melanoma

```

```{r export_spot_dictionary}

```

## Visium normalization

```{r normalization_memory}

options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)

```

```{r create_spatial_objects}

objects <- lapply(samples$sample, function(sid) {
    info <- samples[match(sid, samples$sample), ]
    seu <- Load10X_Spatial(file.path(raw_dir, sid), assay = "Spatial", slice = "slice1", filter.matrix = TRUE, 
        to.upper = FALSE)
    seu$sample <- sid
    seu$patient <- info$patient
    seu$pair <- info$pair
    seu$met_status <- ifelse(info$outcome == "M+", "met", "nmet")
    subset(seu, cells = colnames(seu)[seu$nFeature_Spatial >= 750])
})
names(objects) <- samples$sample

```

```{r select_integration_features}

ranked_objects <- lapply(objects, function(seu) {
    DefaultAssay(seu) <- "Spatial"
    seu <- NormalizeData(seu, verbose = FALSE)
    FindVariableFeatures(seu, nfeatures = 3000, verbose = FALSE)
})
eligible <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(ranked_objects, function(seu) rownames(seu)[Matrix::rowSums(LayerData(seu[['Spatial']], layer = 'counts') > 0) >= 5]))
ranked <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(ranked_objects, nfeatures = min(10000, length(eligible)), assay = rep('Spatial', length(objects)), verbose = FALSE)
features <- head(ranked[ranked %in% eligible], 3000)

```

```{r normalize_sct}

objects <- lapply(ranked_objects, function(seu) {
    print(paste0("Normalizing ", unique(seu$sample)))
    seu <- SCTransform(seu, assay = "Spatial", new.assay.name = "SCT", vst.flavor = "v2", method = "glmGamPoi", 
        residual.features = features, variable.features.n = 3000, return.only.var.genes = TRUE, conserve.memory = TRUE, 
        verbose = FALSE, seed.use = 20260802)
    VariableFeatures(seu[["SCT"]]) <- features
    seu
})
rm(ranked_objects)

```

## Visium RPCA integration

```{r assign_unique_spot_names}

for (sid in names(objects)) objects[[sid]] <- RenameCells(objects[[sid]], add.cell.id = sid)
spot_ids <- unlist(lapply(objects, colnames), use.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(list(sections = objects, features = features), file.path(intermediate_dir, 'visium_sct_checkpoint.rds'))

```

```{r integrate_rpca}

prepared <- PrepSCTIntegration(objects, anchor.features = features, verbose = FALSE)
prepared <- lapply(prepared, function(seu) RunPCA(seu, assay = 'SCT', features = features, npcs = 30, reduction.name = 'pca', seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE))
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(prepared, normalization.method = 'SCT', anchor.features = features, reduction = 'rpca', dims = 1:30, k.anchor = 5, verbose = FALSE)
integrated <- IntegrateData(anchors, normalization.method = 'SCT', dims = 1:30, new.assay.name = 'integratedRPCA', verbose = FALSE)

```

```{r embed_integrated_spots}

DefaultAssay(integrated) <- 'integratedRPCA'
integrated <- RunPCA(integrated, features = features, npcs = 30, reduction.name = 'pca_rpca', reduction.key = 'rPC_', seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE)
integrated <- RunUMAP(integrated, reduction = 'pca_rpca', dims = 1:30, n.components = 2, n.neighbors = 30, min.dist = 0.30, metric = 'cosine', reduction.name = 'umap_rpca', reduction.key = 'rUMAP_', seed.use = 20260802, verbose = FALSE)
integration <- list(features = features, reductions = integrated@reductions, metadata = integrated[[]])
rm(prepared, anchors)

```

## Visium MAGIC imputation

```{r configure_magic}

library(reticulate)
use_condaenv('r_reticulate_env', required = TRUE)

```

```{r assemble_expression}

expression <- assemble_section_expression(objects)
embedding <- Embeddings(integrated, 'pca_rpca')[, 1:30]
expression <- expression[, rownames(embedding), drop = FALSE]
expression_t <- t(as.matrix(expression))
rm(integrated)

```

```{r impute_magic}

np <- import('numpy', convert = FALSE)
graphtools <- import('graphtools', convert = FALSE)
magic <- import('magic', convert = FALSE)
graph <- graphtools$Graph(np$array(embedding), knn = 5L, decay = 1L, n_pca = NULL, random_state = 20260828L)
model <- magic$MAGIC(knn = 5L, decay = 1L, t = 3L, n_pca = NULL, random_state = 20260828L, verbose = 0L)
expression_python <- np$array(expression_t)
model$fit(expression_python, graph = graph)
imputed <- t(py_to_r(model$transform(X = expression_python, genes = 'all_genes')))
rm(expression_python, expression_t)
dimnames(imputed) <- dimnames(expression)
saveRDS(list(expression = imputed, integration = integration), file.path(intermediate_dir, 'visium_magic_checkpoint.rds'))

```

## Visium metaprogram scores

```{r select_melanoma_spots}

programs <- c('differentiated_melanocytic', 'epithelial_adjacent', 'mesenchymal_invasive', 'proliferation_cell_cycle', 'early_developmental_stress', 'nevus_like_senescence', 'ifn_associated_stress')
melanoma_spots <- weights$spot[as.logical(weights$melanoma_analysis)]

```

```{r score_metaprogrammes}

signatures <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, 'metaprogrammes.rds'))
expression <- imputed[, melanoma_spots, drop = FALSE]
score_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = expression)
score_obj <- SetAssayData(score_obj, layer = 'data', new.data = expression)
score_obj <- AddModuleScore(score_obj, features = signatures[programs], name = 'MP_', ctrl = 100, nbin = 24, seed = 20260805)
scores <- data.frame(spot = colnames(score_obj), score_obj[[]][paste0('MP_', 1:7)], check.names = FALSE)
names(scores)[2:8] <- programs
scores$sample <- sub('_[^_]+$', '', scores$spot)
scores$patient <- patient_from_spot(scores$spot)
rm(expression, score_obj)

```

```{r load_xenium_reference}

xenium_path <- file.path(xenium_dir, 'final_annotation.rds')
xenium_annotations <- readRDS(xenium_path)
xenium <- xenium_annotations[xenium_annotations$main_lineage == 'Melanoma', c('patient', 'melanoma_mp', programs)]
xenium$sample <- paste0(xenium$patient, '_1')

```

```{r calibrate_metaprogram_scores}

quantile_map <- function(x, reference) {
    ranks <- (rank(x, ties.method = "average") - 0.5)/length(x)
    as.numeric(quantile(reference, probs = ranks, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7))
}
calibrated <- scores
for (sid in unique(scores$sample)) {
    selected <- scores$sample == sid
    reference <- xenium[xenium$sample == sid, ]
    for (program in programs) calibrated[selected, program] <- quantile_map(scores[selected, program], reference[[program]])
}
write.csv(calibrated, file.path(result_dir, "Visium_calibrated_metaprogram_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

## Spatial metaprogram scores

```{r spatial_metaprogram_maps}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  score_colors <- c('#3B4CC0', '#39BEB1', '#F4E55C', '#E85D3F', '#9E0142')
  program_names <- names(signatures[programs])
  metaprogram_scores <- calibrated
  selected <- c('differentiated_melanocytic', 'epithelial_adjacent', 'mesenchymal_invasive', 'nevus_like_senescence')
  labels <- c('Melanocytic', 'Epithelial-adjacent', 'Mesenchymal-invasive', 'Nevus-like')

  for (sid in c("thinmme003_1", "thinmme006_1")) {
      patient <- samples$patient[match(sid, samples$sample)]
      seu <- objects[[sid]]
      section_scores <- metaprogram_scores[startsWith(metaprogram_scores$spot, paste0(sid, "_")), ]
      seu <- assign_spot_meta(seu, section_scores, program_names)
      limit <- quantile(abs(unlist(section_scores[program_names])), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
      panels <- SpatialFeaturePlot(seu, features = selected, pt.size.factor = 3, image.alpha = 0.4, combine = FALSE)
      panels <- Map(function(plot, label) {
          plot + labs(title = label, fill = NULL) + scale_fill_gradientn(colors = score_colors, values = scales::rescale(c(-limit, 
              -limit/2, 0, limit/2, limit)), limits = c(-limit, limit), oob = scales::squish) + guides(fill = guide_colorbar(direction = "horizontal")) + theme_void(base_size = 10) + 
              theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
      }, panels, labels)
      panel <- wrap_plots(panels, nrow = 1, guides = "collect") + plot_annotation(title = patient)
      panel <- panel & theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 8))
      save_panel(panel, paste0("Figure_4A_", patient, "_metaprograms.pdf"), 8, 3)
  }
}))
```

## Visium metaprogram membership

```{r compare_membership_composition}

xenium_composition <- xenium %>% count(sample, program = melanoma_mp, name = 'N') %>% complete(sample, program = programs, fill = list(N = 0)) %>% group_by(sample) %>% mutate(xenium_fraction = N / sum(N)) %>% ungroup()
calibrated_matrix <- as.matrix(calibrated[programs])
compute_composition <- function(threshold) {
    membership <- as.data.frame(calibrated_matrix >= threshold)
    membership$sample <- calibrated$sample
    composition <- membership %>% pivot_longer(all_of(programs), names_to = "program", values_to = "member") %>% 
        group_by(sample, program) %>% summarise(N = sum(member), .groups = "drop") %>%
      group_by(sample) %>% mutate(visium_fraction = N/sum(N)) %>% ungroup()
    inner_join(composition, xenium_composition, by = c("sample", "program"), suffix = c("_visium", "_xenium"))
}

```

```{r select_membership_threshold}

grid <- lapply(seq(-0.4, 0.4, 0.05), function(threshold) {
    composition <- compute_composition(threshold)
    per_patient <- composition %>% group_by(sample) %>% summarise(rho = cor(visium_fraction, xenium_fraction, method = "spearman"), 
        .groups = "drop")
    data.frame(threshold = threshold, median_spearman = median(per_patient$rho, na.rm = TRUE), mae = mean(abs(composition$visium_fraction - 
        composition$xenium_fraction)))
})
grid <- bind_rows(grid) %>% mutate(joint_score = (median_spearman + 1 - mae) / 2)
best <- grid %>% filter(joint_score == max(joint_score, na.rm = TRUE))
set.seed(20260805)
best <- best[sample.int(nrow(best), 1), ]
write.csv(grid, file.path(result_dir, "Visium_membership_thresholds.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r plot_membership_threshold}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  thresholds <- grid
  selected <- best$threshold

  thresholds <- thresholds %>% mutate(composition_agreement = 1 - mae) %>% pivot_longer(c(median_spearman, composition_agreement), names_to = 'metric', values_to = 'value')
  thresholds$metric <- factor(thresholds$metric, levels = c('median_spearman', 'composition_agreement'), labels = c('Median Spearman rho', 'Composition agreement (1 - MAE)'))
  plot <- ggplot(thresholds, aes(threshold, value, color = metric)) + geom_vline(xintercept = selected, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'grey25') + geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) + geom_point(size = 1) + scale_color_manual(values = c('#0072B2', '#D55E00')) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-0.4, 0.4, 0.2)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) + labs(x = 'Membership threshold (calibrated score)', y = 'Composition recovery', color = NULL) + theme_classic(base_size = 9) + theme(legend.position = 'top', legend.text = element_text(size = 7)) + guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
  save_panel(plot, 'Supplementary_Figure_13C_membership_threshold.pdf', 4, 3)
}))

```

```{r assign_metaprogram_membership}

member <- as.data.frame(calibrated_matrix >= best$threshold)
assignment <- cbind(calibrated[c('spot', 'sample', 'patient')], member)
composition <- compute_composition(best$threshold)
composition$patient <- samples$patient[match(composition$sample, samples$sample)]
membership <- list(assignment = assignment, threshold = best$threshold, composition = composition)
write.csv(assignment, file.path(result_dir, "Visium_metaprogram_membership.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(composition, file.path(result_dir, "Visium_metaprogram_composition.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r metaprogram_cell_composition}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  program_names <- names(signatures[programs])
  lineages <- c('Melanoma', 'Lymphocyte', 'Myeloid', 'Endothelial', 'Fibroblast', 'Epithelial', 'Stroma')
  weights <- weights[match(assignment$spot, weights$spot), ]

  composition <- lapply(program_names, function(program) {
      member <- assignment[[program]]
      data.frame(metaprogram = program, lineage = lineages, percent = 100 * colMeans(weights[member, lineages, drop = FALSE]))
  })

  write.csv(composition, file.path(result_dir, "Supplementary_Figure_13G_cell_composition.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  program_order <- c('epithelial_adjacent', 'early_developmental_stress', 'proliferation_cell_cycle', 'differentiated_melanocytic', 'ifn_associated_stress', 'nevus_like_senescence', 'mesenchymal_invasive')
  program_labels <- c('Epithelial-adjacent', 'Developmental', 'Proliferative', 'Melanocytic', 'IFN-associated', 'Nevus-like', 'MES')
  composition$metaprogram <- factor(composition$metaprogram, levels = program_order, labels = program_labels)
  composition$lineage <- factor(composition$lineage, levels = rev(lineages))
  plot <- ggplot(composition, aes(metaprogram, lineage, fill = percent)) + geom_tile(color = 'white', linewidth = 0.2) + geom_text(aes(label = sprintf('%.1f', percent)), size = 2) + scale_fill_gradient(low = 'white', high = '#3182BD', name = 'Mean relative weight (%)') + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 8) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = 'bottom')
  save_panel(plot, 'Supplementary_Figure_13G_cell_composition.pdf', 4.8, 3)
}))

```

## Visium trajectory projection

```{r trajectory_projection_helpers}

library(destiny)
library(slingshot)
features <- setdiff(programs, 'proliferation_cell_cycle')

```

```{r prepare_trajectory_projection}

parameters <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, 'xenium_score_scaling.csv'))
center <- setNames(parameters$tmp_mean, parameters$melanoma_mp)[features]
scale_sd <- setNames(parameters$tmp_sd, parameters$melanoma_mp)[features]
scaled <- scale(as.matrix(calibrated[features]), center = center, scale = scale_sd)
scaled[scaled > 3] <- 3
scaled[scaled < -3] <- -3
rownames(scaled) <- calibrated$spot
melanoma <- readRDS(file.path(xenium_dir, 'melanoma_analysis.rds'))
dm <- melanoma@misc$trajectory_models$diffusion_map
fit <- melanoma@misc$trajectory_models$slingshot
training <- trajectory_training_view(melanoma)
rm(melanoma)
order <- colnames(get('data', envir = dm@data_env))

```

```{r project_spot_trajectories}

coordinates <- destiny::dm_predict(dm, scaled[, order, drop = FALSE])[, 1:3, drop = FALSE]
coordinates <- sweep(coordinates, 2, training$signs, '*')
colnames(coordinates) <- paste0('DC', 1:3)
projected <- slingshot::predict(fit, newdata = as.data.frame(coordinates))
pt <- slingPseudotime(projected, na = FALSE)
weights <- slingCurveWeights(projected, as.probs = FALSE)
trajectory <- data.frame(spot = calibrated$spot, pt_route1 = pt[, 1], pt_route2 = pt[, 2], w1 = weights[, 1], w2 = weights[, 2])

```

```{r align_shared_trunk}

xenium <- xenium_annotations %>% filter(main_lineage == 'Melanoma') %>% transmute(pt_route1 = pt_route1_raw, pt_route2 = pt_route2_raw, w1, w2, pt_merged = (pt_route1_raw + pt_route2_raw) / 2)
skeleton <- make_centerline(xenium %>% filter(w1 + w2 >= 1.5), 'pt_merged')
nearest <- nearest_on_skeleton(as.matrix(trajectory[c('pt_route1', 'pt_route2')]), as.matrix(skeleton[c('pt_route1_s', 'pt_route2_s')]))
trajectory$pt_route2 <- trajectory$pt_route2 - (nearest$pt2_line - nearest$pt1_line)
trajectory <- trajectory %>% mutate(pt_merged = (pt_route1 + pt_route2) / 2, pt_class = case_when(w1 + w2 >= 1.5 ~ 'Shared Trunk', w2 < w1 ~ 'Lineage 1', w1 < w2 ~ 'Lineage 2', TRUE ~ 'Shared Trunk'))

```

```{r fit_trajectory_centrelines}

skeleton <- bind_rows(make_centerline(trajectory, 'pt_merged', 'Shared Trunk', 15, 10, 0.25), make_centerline(trajectory, 'pt_route1', 'Lineage 1', 20, 10, 0.30), make_centerline(trajectory, 'pt_route2', 'Lineage 2', 20, 10, 0.30))
trajectory$cl_dist <- NA_real_
for (lineage in unique(trajectory$pt_class)) {
    selected <- which(trajectory$pt_class == lineage)
    s <- skeleton[skeleton$pt_class == lineage, ]
    trajectory$cl_dist[selected] <- vapply(selected, function(i) sqrt(min((s$pt_route1_s - trajectory$pt_route1[i])^2 + 
        (s$pt_route2_s - trajectory$pt_route2[i])^2)), numeric(1))
}
threshold <- mean(trajectory$cl_dist) + 3 * sd(trajectory$cl_dist)
trajectory$cl_far <- trajectory$cl_dist > threshold
trajectory$patient <- patient_from_spot(trajectory$spot)

```

## Visium trajectory correction

```{r correct_projection_outliers}

jitter <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, 'visium_retained_jitter.rds'))
selected <- which(trajectory$cl_far)
index <- match(trajectory$spot[selected], jitter$spot)
trajectory$pt_route1[selected] <- jitter$pt_route1[index]
trajectory$pt_route2[selected] <- jitter$pt_route2[index]

```

```{r classify_trajectory_branches}

fork <- 0.056
trajectory <- trajectory %>% mutate(pt_merged = (pt_route1 + pt_route2) / 2, pt_class = case_when(pt_merged < fork ~ 'Shared Trunk', w2 < w1 ~ 'Lineage 1', w1 < w2 ~ 'Lineage 2', TRUE ~ 'Shared Trunk'), sample = sub('_[^_]+$', '', spot)) %>%
  select(spot, patient, sample, pt_route1, pt_route2, w1, w2, pt_merged, pt_class)

```

```{r export_spot_trajectories}

write.csv(trajectory, file.path(result_dir, "Visium_trajectory.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

## Corrected trajectories in tissue and relative to Xenium

```{r spatial_trajectory_maps}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  lineage_colors <- c('Lineage 1' = '#E377C2', 'Lineage 2' = '#353C40', 'Shared Trunk' = '#BDBDBD')
  for (sid in c("thinmme003_1", "thinmme006_1")) {
      patient <- samples$patient[match(sid, samples$sample)]
      seu <- objects[[sid]]
      seu <- assign_spot_meta(seu, trajectory, "pt_class")
      seu$pt_class <- factor(seu$pt_class, levels = names(lineage_colors))
      classes <- SpatialDimPlot(seu, group.by = "pt_class", pt.size.factor = 3, image.alpha = 0.4, cols = lineage_colors) +
        guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) + labs(title = patient, fill = NULL) + theme_void(base_size = 10) + 
          theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "bottom")
      save_panel(classes, paste0("Figure_4B_", patient, "_trajectories.pdf"), 3, 3)
  }
}))

```

```{r compare_lineage_composition}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  xenium <- xenium_annotations %>% filter(main_lineage == 'Melanoma') %>% transmute(sample = paste0(patient, '_1'), pt_class)
  classes <- c('Shared Trunk', 'Lineage 1', 'Lineage 2')

  composition <- function(data) {
      data %>% filter(pt_class %in% classes) %>% dplyr::count(sample, pt_class) %>% complete(sample, pt_class = classes, 
          fill = list(n = 0)) %>% group_by(sample) %>% mutate(fraction = n/sum(n)) %>% ungroup()
  }
  lineage <- inner_join(composition(trajectory), composition(xenium), by = c('sample', 'pt_class'), suffix = c('_visium', '_xenium'))
  lineage$patient <- samples$patient[match(lineage$sample, samples$sample)]
  write.csv(lineage, file.path(result_dir, "Visium_lineage_composition.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  lineage$pt_class <- factor(lineage$pt_class, levels = classes)
  save_panel(comparison_plot(lineage, 'fraction_xenium', 'fraction_visium', 'pt_class'), 'Supplementary_Figure_13F_lineage_composition.pdf', 6, 2.5)
}))

```

```{r plot_corrected_trajectory_projection}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  lineage_colors <- c('Lineage 1' = '#E377C2', 'Lineage 2' = '#353C40', 'Shared Trunk' = '#BDBDBD')
  program_names <- names(signatures[programs])
  metaprogram_scores <- calibrated

  index <- match(trajectory$spot, metaprogram_scores$spot)
  trajectory$metaprogram <- program_names[max.col(as.matrix(metaprogram_scores[index, program_names]), ties.method = 'first')]
  skeleton <- bind_rows(make_centerline(trajectory, 'pt_merged', 'Shared Trunk', 15, 10, 0.25), make_centerline(trajectory, 'pt_route1', 'Lineage 1', 20, 10, 0.30), make_centerline(trajectory, 'pt_route2', 'Lineage 2', 20, 10, 0.30))
  centroids <- trajectory %>% group_by(metaprogram) %>% summarise(pt_route1 = median(pt_route1), pt_route2 = median(pt_route2), .groups = 'drop')
  program_colors <- c(differentiated_melanocytic = 'brown', epithelial_adjacent = '#009E73', mesenchymal_invasive = 'pink', proliferation_cell_cycle = 'indianred', early_developmental_stress = 'goldenrod', nevus_like_senescence = '#D55E00', ifn_associated_stress = 'coral')
  program_labels <- c(differentiated_melanocytic = 'Melanocytic', epithelial_adjacent = 'Epithelial-adjacent', mesenchymal_invasive = 'MES', proliferation_cell_cycle = 'Proliferative', early_developmental_stress = 'Developmental', nevus_like_senescence = 'Nevus-like', ifn_associated_stress = 'IFN-associated')

  plot <- ggplot(trajectory, aes(pt_route1, pt_route2, color = metaprogram)) + ggrastr::geom_point_rast(alpha = 0.5, size = 1, raster.dpi = 300) + geom_path(data = skeleton, aes(pt_route1_s, pt_route2_s, color = pt_class), linewidth = 1, lineend = 'round') + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'gray67') + geom_point(data = centroids, shape = 23, fill = 'white', size = 3) + scale_color_manual(values = c(program_colors, lineage_colors), labels = c(program_labels, setNames(names(lineage_colors), names(lineage_colors)))) + labs(x = 'Pseudotime Lineage 1', y = 'Pseudotime Lineage 2', color = NULL) + theme_bw(base_size = 9) + guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 2)))
  save_panel(plot, 'Supplementary_Figure_13E_trajectory_projection.pdf', 6, 3.5)
}))

```
